data.narrative:
Liminal Insights is a Series A climate and energy company founded by Barry Van Tassell and Shaurjo Biswas that has raised $38.9M to date. The Climate & Energy sector comprises a comparable universe of nine private peers (including Helion, Redwood Materials, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen) and one public reference point (LNZA), though narrow peer alignment at identical stage and valuation tier remains limited.

Valuation analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, the only applicable triangulation approach given insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables meeting minimum threshold (≥3 datapoints). Using total capital raised ($39M) as a base proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A progression yields an implied valuation of $78M. This single-method result is supported by a reasonable range of $66M–$89M, derived from conservative and optimistic variance around the derived median.

The analysis supports a valuation of approximately $78M, with a plausible range of $66M–$89M. Key uncertainties include the absence of direct peer multiples in Climate & Energy at matched stage and size; reliance on stage-progression alone introduces dependency on multiplier assumption rather than market-derived metrics. Revenue, margin profile, and capital efficiency relative to named competitors remain unobservable and should anchor any further refinement.
